PROJECT OVERVIEW
Item

Title of the Project
HOMEFIX — Smart Home Service Booking System with Intelligent Technician Recommendation
Brief Description
HOMEFIX is a full-stack web application designed to connect households with verified, reliable technicians across essential service domains (electrical, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and cleaning). It features a 5-factor rule-based recommendation engine that evaluates specialization, proximity via Haversine distance and pincode, availability, rating, experience, and visiting charges. The system incorporates complaint registration with photo uploads via Multer, voice input via Web Speech API, role-based dashboards for Users, Technicians, and Admin, full service lifecycle tracking, diagnostic tool/material suggestions, demo payment/payout workflows, and verified customer reviews.
Domain of the Project
Web Applications / Intelligent Recommendation Systems / Service Management
Tools / Frameworks
• Frontend: React.js 18, Vite, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 5, Bootstrap Icons, React Router DOM v6
• Backend: Node.js (ESM), Express.js, JWT (jsonwebtoken), bcryptjs, Multer
• Database: MySQL Server / MySQL Workbench (12 Relational Tables)
• Speech & Payment: Browser Web Speech API, Razorpay SDK (Test/Demo Mode)
• Version Control: Git, GitHub
Relevant SDG(s)
SDG 8 (Decent Work & Economic Growth), SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure), SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities & Communities), SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption & Production)
Relevant POs

SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Provides informal trade technicians (electricians, plumbers, carpenters) with a formal digital marketplace to access verified customer bookings, organize work schedules, establish credible professional reputations through customer ratings, and secure transparent, trackable earnings with structured payout ledgers.

SDG 9: Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure
Modernizes the informal household maintenance sector through technological innovation by deploying an intelligent rule-based multi-criteria recommendation engine, multimodal complaint registration (image and voice inputs), and an end-to-end digital service tracking infrastructure.
3
SDG 11: Sustainable Cities and Communities
Enhances urban living standards and neighborhood safety by facilitating rapid, localized maintenance of essential domestic electrical, sanitary, and utility systems, preventing severe domestic hazards and promoting resilient community infrastructure.
4
SDG 12: Responsible Consumption and Production
Promotes sustainable domestic appliance usage by enabling timely diagnostic repair and servicing, extending the operational lifecycle of household electronics and plumbing utilities, reducing premature appliance disposal, and curbing electronic waste.

DATABASE AND USER INTERFACE DESIGN
Attach or paste ER diagrams, database schema, screen designs, wireframes, navigation flow, and brief notes.
1. Relational Database Schema Architecture (MySQL - homefix database)
The HOMEFIX persistence layer comprises 12 normalized relational tables designed in MySQL Workbench (InnoDB engine, utf8mb4): • users: Stores system credentials, phone, address, city, pincode, bcrypt password hash, and role (user, technician, admin). • services: Service catalog (Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, AC/Appliance, Painting, Cleaning) with base price and icon metadata. • technician_profiles: 1-to-1 extension of users storing specialization (service_id), experience, hourly/visiting fees, geographic coordinates, rating, availability status (available, busy, offline), and admin verification status (pending, verified, rejected). • bookings: Central complaint/service entity capturing booking_reference, problem title/description, photo URL (Multer), voice URL, schedule slot, status machine, and estimated/final costs. • technician_recommendations: Stores rule-based match scores (0-100), rank positions, and criteria score breakdown JSON. • payments & technician_payouts: Billing transactions (Demo/Razorpay) and settlement ledger (85% technician net, 15% platform commission). • service_status_logs & tool_material_suggestions: Status audit trail and diagnostic suggestions mapped to problem keywords. • reviews & admin_logs: 1-to-5 star verified reviews and administrative operation audit trail.
2. Entity-Relationship & Data Flow Dependencies
• users (1) ───< bookings (M) [ON DELETE CASCADE] • technician_profiles (1) ───< bookings (M) [ON DELETE SET NULL] • services (1) ───< bookings (M) [ON DELETE RESTRICT] • bookings (1) ───< technician_recommendations (M) [ON DELETE CASCADE] • bookings (1) ─── (1) payments (1) ─── (1) technician_payouts [ON DELETE CASCADE] • bookings (1) ─── (1) reviews [rating TINYINT CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)] • bookings (1) ───< service_status_logs (M) [Complete status lifecycle audit]
3. User Interface Design & Role-Based Screen Navigation
• Customer Portal: Home landing page (Home.jsx) with service discovery; Multi-step complaint registration (BookService.jsx) supporting photo attachment and voice input recording via Web Speech API; Tracking dashboard (MyBookings.jsx) showing real-time status badges, technician match cards, Test/Demo payment modal, and post-service review dialog. • Technician Portal: Dedicated workspace (Dashboard.jsx) with live availability toggle (Available/Busy/Offline), assigned booking queue, accept/reject modal with reason logging, progress update controls (Start Service / Complete Service), tool and material suggestion viewer, and earnings ledger. • Administrator Portal: Executive overview featuring KPI summary cards (Total Bookings, Active Users, Verified Technicians, Gross Revenue, Platform Commission), technician verification review queue (Approve/Reject), customer directory, technician settlement ledger, and system audit logs.
